artworks.title: Eos Lifting the Body of Memnon (Douris kylix)
artworks.description: Douris' Louvre kylix — Dawn gathers her son's corpse after Achilles' duel, the Aethiopis grief made red-figure.

artworks.title: Hydria with the Fight of Achilles and Memnon
artworks.description: Corinthian hydria — Achilles and Memnon locked in combat, Thetis and Eos at their sons' sides.

artworks.title: Achilles and Memnon between Thetis and Eos
artworks.description: Attic black-figure — the two mothers watch as Achilles and Memnon fight for Troy's last eastern ally.

artworks.title: Achilles Fighting Memnon
artworks.description: Leiden vase — the Aethiopian king against Achilles, the duel that ends Memnon's brief aristeia.

artworks.title: Monteleone Chariot (Achilles and Memnon panel)
artworks.description: Etruscan bronze chariot panel — Achilles and Memnon's combat carried west of Greece, the Aethiopis in ivory and bronze.
